canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Brinis Drenin: 39-year-old woman, 165 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: wide triangular face; large hooded eyes and a broken brow line; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: offset gathered mass. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: one bounded geometric forearm tattoo; a shaped cloth clasp; a shallow cheek scar. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: deliberately tousled but clean. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
